title: Digital Marketing Coordinator
description:
After clicking Apply, you'll be invited to create a profile on the Via website to complete your application. This doesn't guarantee you'll be matched to this specific role - Via reviews every application (AI first, then a human checks the fit) and shortlists the right candidates. Your profile also stays active for other relevant roles on the platform, and stays anonymous until you match. It takes just a few minutes.

Salary: £35,000-£42,000 per year

Working arrangement: Hybrid

Start date: Flexible

Full-time Permanent

About the opportunity

Via is partnering with a leading UK housebuilder looking for a Digital Marketing Coordinator to support its digital campaigns, website, content and customer journey.

Working closely with the Head of Digital, you'll help deliver marketing activity across email, PPC, SEO, display advertising, property portals and the company website.

It's a varied role that combines hands-on digital marketing with performance analysis. You'll help keep online content accurate and engaging, support campaigns designed to generate new customer enquiries and use performance data to identify opportunities to improve results.

Previous property or housebuilding experience would be useful but isn't essential. We're more interested in candidates with a good foundation in digital marketing who are comfortable working across several channels and want to develop their skills further.

What you'll be doing
- Coordinate digital marketing campaigns across email, PPC, SEO, display and other channels
- Support listings and campaigns across property portals such as Rightmove
- Help create, schedule and deliver customer email and lifecycle campaigns
- Support marketing automation activity
- Monitor campaigns against agreed KPIs and identify opportunities to improve performance
- Carry out keyword research and support SEO activity
- Make on-page SEO and content improvements
- Maintain and update website content through a CMS
- Ensure online content, imagery and information remain accurate and up to date
- Work with sales teams to maintain property and development information
- Help improve the online customer journey and website user experience
- Support the development and testing of new digital features and tools
- Track website and campaign performance
- Monitor traffic, engagement, conversion rates and cost per lead
- Use Google Analytics, Looker Studio, HubSpot and Excel to analyse performance
- Help produce monthly reports for sales teams and senior stakeholders
- Turn performance data into practical recommendations
- Work with internal teams and external partners on digital projects
- Ensure digital content remains consistent with brand standards
- Support the Head of Digital and wider marketing team with additional projects

What we're looking for
- Previous experience in digital marketing or a broader marketing role with strong digital exposure
- Good understanding of digital marketing fundamentals
- Experience working across multiple digital marketing channels
- Familiarity with website CMS platforms
- Understanding of email marketing and marketing automation
- Familiarity with PPC and digital advertising
- Understanding of SEO principles
- Comfortable working with digital marketing data and performance metrics
- Experience with Google Analytics or similar analytics tools
- Strong Excel skills
- Understanding of the online customer journey and conversion
- Strong written and verbal communication skills
- Excellent attention to detail
- Good organisation and the ability to manage several priorities at once
- Analytical and curious approach to marketing performance
- Comfortable working in a fast-paced environment
- Strong collaboration and stakeholder management skills
- Proactive approach and willingness to learn

Experience with HubSpot, Looker Studio, property portals or similar tools would be particularly useful.

Previous experience within housebuilding, property, real estate or another consumer sector with a considered customer journey would be an advantage, but isn't essential.

A marketing, digital, business or related degree would be useful, although equivalent practical experience will also be considered.

Why apply?
- £35,000-£42,000 salary
- Company bonus scheme
- Hybrid and flexible working opportunities
- 25 days' annual leave
- Private healthcare and cash plan options
- Private pension
- ShareSave scheme
- Cycle to work scheme
- Gym membership discounts
- Work across a broad range of digital marketing channels
- Exposure to PPC, SEO, email, CRM, analytics and website optimisation
- Opportunity to work closely with an experienced Head of Digital
- Strong scope for learning and professional development

If you're an early-career digital marketer looking for a varied role where you can build experience across campaigns, content, analytics and customer experience, we'd like to hear from you.

title: Credit Controller
description:
Powered by Water, Driven by Purpose

SES Business Water provides water and wastewater services for businesses across England and Scotland. Our customers include major high street retailers, supermarkets, hospitality and leisure, local and national government, NHS, independent schools, manufacturing, food processing and an international airport.

We're proud to be part of Pennon Group, a leader in the UK water sector, working towards a greener future. Our goals? As well as lowering our carbon footprint, we're working with partners to plant 300,000 trees, restore peatlands and supporting farmers and landowners to improve water quality and wildlife.

Whether you're starting out or seeking a new challenge, our scale and ambition create opportunities for you to shape your own career.

Ready to make a splash? Join our team today.

Credit Controller

Redhill Hybrid Working £28,000 - £31,000 depending on experience

Join SES Business Water

We're looking for a proactive and customer-focused Credit Controller to join our Customer Service Collections team. This is an excellent opportunity for someone with experience in debt recovery, account management, or credit control who enjoys balancing strong customer service with achieving business outcomes.

You'll take ownership of a portfolio of customer accounts, working with customers to resolve outstanding balances, negotiate payment arrangements, and ensure a positive customer experience while reducing bad debt exposure.

What you'll be doing:
- Managing a portfolio of customer accounts with overdue debt
- Contacting customers by phone, email, and written correspondence to secure payment
- Investigating and resolving account queries and disputes
- Negotiating and agreeing payment arrangements
- Reconciling customer accounts and validating billing information
- Working closely with Billing, Finance, Sales, and Metering teams to resolve issues
- Managing cases involving financial difficulties, insolvencies, and deceased customers
- Recommending appropriate recovery actions to minimise bad debt
- Maintaining accurate customer records and updating recovery actions
- Supporting continuous improvement projects and process enhancements
- Promoting Direct Debit and other suitable payment methods

What we're looking for:

We're keen to hear from candidates who have:
- Experience managing customer accounts and recovering outstanding debt
- Experience reconciling accounts and resolving billing queries
- Understanding of debt management processes and associated legal procedures
- Strong communication and negotiation skills
- Good organisational skills and attention to detail
- Ability to work independently while contributing positively to a team
- GCSE Maths and English (or equivalent)
- Confident use of Microsoft Office applications including Excel, Outlook, Teams and Word

Desirable
- Experience within a utilities or water industry environment
- Knowledge of customer billing and payment allocation processes
- Experience using HiAffinity or a similar CRM/customer management system

Why join us?

At SES Business Water, you'll be part of a supportive team that values collaboration, customer service and continuous improvement. You'll have the opportunity to develop your skills, contribute to meaningful business outcomes, and play an important role in helping our customers manage their accounts effectively.
- Competitive Salary - Based on experience and skills
- Bonus Scheme - Rewarding your performance
- Pension Scheme - Helping you plan for your future
- Healthcare Benefits - Access to employee assistance programs
- Professional Development - Support for career growth with training opportunities
- Employee Discounts - On various products and services
- Generous Annual Leave - Take time to recharge with our holiday entitlement

Closing Date: 9th October 2026

We may close this vacancy early if we receive a high volume of applications. We encourage you to apply as soon as possible.

Please note that the successful candidate will be subject to a mandatory DBS check as part of the onboarding process.

Be yourself, we like it that way. Together, we will build a culture of belonging, where inclusion is instinctive. Diversity is our strength and a reflection of our communities. We care, we value everyone, we celebrate uniqueness.

Our core values, which are essential to our success, are:

Be Rock Solid - Build trust and be trusted. Be the one we all look to and can depend on.

Be You - We want you to bring your best everyday. Be yourself and make your mark in your individual way.

Be the Future - Embrace change. Drive Progress. Own the challenge.

You should be comfortable using everyday applications such as Microsoft Office and have an interest in the rapidly evolving world of Artificial Intelligence (AI).

Experience using AI platforms such as ChatGPT and Google Gemini would be highly advantageous. You'll also have the opportunity to explore and embrace emerging AI technologies, including Microsoft Dragon Copilot, as the business continues to adopt new tools and ways of working.

What You'll Be Doing

Your responsibilities will be varied and may include:

Providing professional and friendly customer service and technical support

Managing customer enquiries and helping to resolve queries efficiently

Coordinating installations, customer training and appointments

Processing and managing customer orders

Monitoring stock levels and assisting with stock management

Supporting the wider team with administrative and organisational tasks

Helping deliver customer training and demonstrations

Assisting with marketing activities and communications

Using technology and AI tools to improve efficiency and support day-to-day operations

Working closely with colleagues across the business to ensure customers receive an excellent experience

Who We're Looking For

We're looking for someone who is:

Enthusiastic, proactive and organised

Confident communicating with customers and colleagues

Comfortable working across multiple tasks and priorities

Naturally curious about technology and keen to learn

Confident using Microsoft Office and everyday digital applications

Interested in AI and emerging technologies

A good problem-solver who enjoys finding practical solutions

Professional, approachable and customer-focused

A strong team player who is happy to get stuck in and take responsibility

Motivated to develop their knowledge and career within a technology-focused organisation

Previous experience in administration, customer service, technical support, coordination or a similar environment would be beneficial, but attitude, enthusiasm and a willingness to learn are equally important.

Why Join?

This is an excellent opportunity for someone who wants more than a traditional administration role.

You'll become an important member of a growing organisation, gaining hands-on experience across technology, customer service, administration, AI, training and marketing.

With technology and AI developing at an incredible pace, this role offers the opportunity to continually expand your skills and knowledge while building a long-term career within a forward-thinking organisation.

If you're bright, personable, technically curious and ready for a varied role where you can make a real contribution, we'd love to hear from you.

Due to the amount of applications we are receiving, we apologise but do not always have the time to respond to everyone individually.

We ask that you apply online initially and not call the office.

If your application is successful, we will call you within 7 days of receipt.

title: Billing & Payables Coordinator
description:
A fast-growing environmental services business in Camberley is looking for a Billing & Payables Coordinator to join its finance team.

You'll look after billing and payment administration across a range of commercial arrangements, checking charges against contracts and investigating anything that doesn't look right. Reporting to the Head of Finance, you'll also support accounts payable and help improve processes as the business expands.

Duties will include:
- Check and process invoices for rent, utilities and other operating costs, making sure charges reflect agreed terms.
- Investigate differences in amounts billed, resolve queries and keep suppliers and business contacts informed.
- Track invoices through to payment, following up on missing information or outstanding items.
- Calculate rebates, assist with rent reviews and keep account records and supporting paperwork organised.
- Work with colleagues across the business to confirm financial information and allocate costs correctly.
- Help the finance team prepare for month-end and year-end.
- Spot recurring problems and suggest practical ways to make billing more reliable and efficient.

About You:

You'll be comfortable working with figures, confident using Excel and willing to investigate an issue through to a resolution. You'll need to organise competing deadlines, work accurately and explain payment queries clearly.

Previous experience in billing, purchase or sales ledger, or a similar finance support position, with exposure to invoice checking, reconciliations or utility accounts particularly helpful.

Familiarity with spreadsheet formulas, lookups or pivot tables would be a bonus, as would experience using accounting or billing software.

The role offers future promotion and career development prospects, alongside the opportunity to be mentored by a highly experienced Head of Finance.

title: Receptionist
description: Practice Plus Group are looking for a Bank Receptionist at our Surrey OOH service to prepare and open a centre for patients, doctors and nurses arrival and ensure patients are seen in a professional manner following the guidelines issued by Practice Plus Group. Our OOH service is open from 19.00-08.00 Monday to Friday and 24 hours over the weekend. We can offer a range of sessions to allow you to flexibly choose the right shift pattern for you. The location for this role is: Royal Surrey County Hospital, Egerton Rd, Guildford, GU2 7XX At Practice Plus Group, were here to make healthcare betterfor patients, clinicians and everyone in between. As one of the UKs largest independent providers of NHS services, we offer consistent, high-quality care through our urgent treatment centres, walk-in clinics, and GP practices. Our Out of Hours Receptionists ensure that even when most of the world has switched off, care continues seamlessly. With a bank contract, youll have the flexibility to pick up shifts that suit your schedule while contributing to a team that truly values compassion and reliability. Youll be the welcoming presence and organised mind that helps keep things running smoothly during our out-of-hours services. Your responsibilities will include: Greeting patients warmly and registering them efficiently Managing telephone enquiries, bookings and patient queries Supporting clinical teams by coordinating patient flow Handling data entry and maintaining accurate records Ensuring the reception area is calm, tidy and professional Adapting quickly to changing demands during busy periods Every shift brings a new set of challenges, and your flexibility will help us meet them with confidence.

title: Administrator
description: As an Administrator with Practice Plus Group IUC, youll provide vital administrative support to the Surrey Out of Hours service, helping ensure the smooth and effective delivery of patient care. Working closely with operational teams and central service departments, youll play an important role in maintaining efficient processes, supporting communication across services and helping ensure day-to-day operations run smoothly. The role involves working with a range of stakeholders, including healthcare professionals, managers and external partners. Youll help coordinate information, maintain accurate records and support activities that contribute to a seamless out of hours service. This is an excellent opportunity for an organised and proactive administrator who enjoys working in a fast-paced environment, takes pride in delivering high-quality support and can effectively manage a varied workload. This is a 3 month fixed term contract. Maintain effective communication between operational staff, managers and supervisors. Support the Admin Lead with daily administrative and operational tasks. Assist with purchase orders, invoicing processes and supplier administration. Coordinate meetings, manage diaries and arrange appointments with internal and external stakeholders. Maintain accurate records and update information within relevant IT systems. Support recruitment administration and maintain training records and communications. Provide administrative support for projects, meetings and minute taking when required. Carry out general office administration, including telephone reception, filing, printing and scanning. Monitor office supplies and support the efficient running of the service. Assist with operational reporting and the timely processing of service documentation.
